name: Wave Paraphonic
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' four wavetable voices tuned to a chord, over its own 33-wave scan line and 17-row chord list. Adds a per-voice wave fan and a continuous interval scaler, neither of which Chords has.

controls.label: Chord
controls.description: Braids' 17-row chord list: sub-semitone unisons, then triads, wide voicings, and octave stacks at the top.

controls.label: Wave
controls.description: Scans the 33-wave line all four voices read, crossfading between neighbours.

controls.label: Fan
controls.description: Offsets each voice further along the scan line, so the four read different waves.

controls.label: Spread
controls.description: Scales every chord interval, from a unison at zero to double width. Braids' voicing at noon.

outputs.main: The four voices summed, as the module has them.
outputs.aux: The root voice on its own, undetuned.
